stories.title: Midterm results deliver ‘youth quake’ to American politics
stories.summary: The 2026 midterm elections delivered a solid blue wave for Democrats on Tuesday, along with a new class of noticeably younger candidates across the board, beating out both new and incumbent senior opponents.
